turns.question: Of the partner outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026, what share got an answer within 12 hours?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that measures replies within 12 hours; the closest are reply rate, messages sent and messages replied, which count a reply whenever it arrived. For 1 to 3 October 2026 the reply rate (reply to any time) was 66.7 % (4 of 6 messages sent), not a 12-hour share. Late: partner_outreach.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
